auditPolicy: Acquired denotes an exact product MOC; overview_only denotes an official or artifact-backed overview; awaiting_geometry denotes a product requiring exact geometry.

products.reason: The official ERO release and field definitions are public, but their exact field geometry has not been converted to an acquired product MOC.
products.manualStep: Extract every field boundary listed by the official ERO fields page, convert each boundary to ICRS polygons, and union the polygons into the Early Release Observations MOC.

products.reason: The official nine-field, 4.8 deg2 summary supports an overview, but exact field geometry has not been converted to a product MOC.
products.manualStep: Extract all nine Galactic Bulge Survey field boundaries from the official Q2 contents, convert them to ICRS polygons, and union the nine polygons into the product MOC.

products.reason: The aggregate published-pointings MOC is a discovery overview; exact instrument observation footprints for the audited snapshot have not been converted to an archive MOC.
products.manualStep: Query MAST for all public HST instrument observations available on 2026-08-12, parse each observation s_region footprint in ICRS, and union the footprints into the Instrument archive snapshot MOC.

products.reason: Published HiPS pointings do not establish exact Hubble Source Catalog coverage, and source-detection footprints for the audited snapshot have not been acquired.
products.manualStep: Query the Hubble Source Catalog available on 2026-08-12, collect the unique contributing HST observation identifiers, resolve each observation s_region footprint from MAST, and union those ICRS footprints into the catalog MOC.

products.reason: Published HiPS pointings do not establish exact Hubble Advanced Products coverage, and product footprints for the audited snapshot have not been acquired.
products.manualStep: Query MAST for all public Hubble Advanced Products available on 2026-08-12, parse each product s_region footprint in ICRS, and union the footprints into the product MOC.

products.reason: The exact CDS DR1 color-imaging MOC is an overview for this differently named registered product; official DR1 stack-image footprints have not been converted to an identity-exact MOC.
products.manualStep: Query the official Pan-STARRS DR1 image metadata for all stack products in the color bands, convert each stack skycell boundary to an ICRS polygon, and union the polygons into the DR1 stacked color imaging MOC.
